correctness.rationale: The proof follows the source's maximizing-chain argument with all quantifiers explicit. Positivity gives a closed upper bound on every intermediate chain point; the source's two-round lower bound supplies a uniform positive lower bound; the Fagnani--Ravazzi inequality then yields a uniform negative decrement. Counting only the \(m-3\) transitions for which both bounds are available gives \(r_A^{(m)}(\gamma)\le 1-(m-3)\eta\) and the stated integer threshold. The near-GV exponent follows from the first derivative of binary entropy and \(-\log(1-x)\) asymptotics. The final code-level statement uses the source's separate finite-round distance theorem with half the target gap reserved as its margin.
